capabilities: Group selected sidebar icons into custom menus
Assign custom SVG icons to groups
Show bound keyboard shortcuts inside menus
Animate popup menus with spring and blur effects
Localize the interface into eight languages
disambiguation: Not a sidebar pane or workspace layout manager; it only groups sidebar icons into hover menus.
extras: Supported on desktop and on mobile in tablet layout.
problem: A vault with many plugins fills the sidebar with icons, making individual ones hard to find.
summary: Plugin that merges selected sidebar icons into custom groups, each opening a hover menu of its actions.
